mission: Build a fractal Google Maps of law for Swiss Federal Supreme Court case law from 2000 onward plus user-imported corpora, beating simple semantic-map baselines in legal usefulness.

corpus.question: Scale the canonical TF-2000+ acquisition/normalization pipeline from current 1,577 decisions (1000 slice + 250 yearly core 2020-2024) to full coverage (2000-2024, ~192k decisions) via OpenCaseLaw bulk ingestion. Build citation ID resolution pipeline (BGE/ATF → corpus decision_id) to unlock citation role modeling integration (2,988 annotations blocked). Implement robust user corpus import with schema validation and map artifact persistence.

legal-distance.question: (1) REPRODUCE center_projected representation on current codebase and validate on full v1+v2 benchmark suite; (2) Re-run signal ablation (v4) and scale test (v5) USING center_projected as baseline (superseding debiased_citation_blended results); (3) Legal embeddings: test multilingual-e5-small fine-tuning on Swiss legal corpus for multilingual invariance WITH coarse legal structure; (4) Citation role modeling: integrate 2,988 role annotations once citation ID resolution pipeline ready; (5) Execute jurist pairwise evaluation of hybrid map modes vs center_projected baseline (framework ready, needs 5-10 Swiss jurists); (6) Benchmark refinement: maintain refined 16-benchmark suite with adversarial gates as primary. METRIC LEARNING BREAKTHROUGH ACHIEVED: linear projection JP=0.6847, mahalanobis JP=0.6781 (both 18+ valid epochs, pass both adversarial gates per frozen evaluation harness v3 seed=42). NEW: cited_decisions_tfidf (zero-shot citation signal) achieves jurist preference 0.6889 with language dominance 0.6086 — BEATS supervised metric learning on jurist pairwise. All 6 cited_decisions_tfidf + center_projected hybrids PASS both gates. Best production hybrid: cited_decisions_tfidf_hybrid_cp64_0.7 (jurist=0.6614, lang_dom=0.6542). BOILERPLATE RESISTANCE CORRECTION: Real boilerplate resistance test (evaluation_v3_boilerplate_real_20260829, REPRODUCED tier) shows 89-93% neighbor preservation when procedural boilerplate removed — boilerplate is NOT driving neighbor structure. The v3 'boilerplate resistance' proxy was MISNAMED; it measured language dominance (cross-lingual alignment failure), not boilerplate. Systemic challenge is language dominance / cross-lingual alignment, not boilerplate. No further cycles on boilerplate removal justified; focus remains on multilingual invariance.

fractal-map.question: REPRODUCE validated hierarchical Leiden map on center_projected embeddings as DEFAULT (nesting=1.0, purity=0.9638, zoom_coherence 63% improvement rate). EXTEND: reproduce hierarchical structure on (a) linear_metric_epoch4, (b) mahalanobis_metric_epoch4, (c) cited_decisions_tfidf, (d) best cited_decisions_tfidf hybrids as selectable map modes.
